name: Jev Knows
tagline: Should I? Yes-or-no answers for hard decisions
description: Jev Knows gives you a yes-or-no read on hard decisions. Ask one question plainly, such as "Should I take the job?", and add as much context about your situation as you like. Jev weighs it against what people have learned, written and lived through, and shows which way that wisdom leans, as a yes/no percentage with the factors it weighed: goal fit, downside, how easy it is to reverse, timing, information and opportunity cost. Add a detail and Jev reads again, up to five times, with every read stacked so you can compare. Free, available in eight languages. The choice stays yours.
